fields.label: Bar follows the focused screen
fields.description: A pinned bar shows only on the screen that has focus and slides across when focus moves, taking its space with it so the windows on both screens move in step. A screen a fullscreen window covers keeps its own staged exit. Off: every screen keeps its bar, and a bar hides in sympathy when a fullscreen window has focus anywhere (the pre-1.2 behaviour).

fields.label: Animate the shell in on start
fields.description: Fade the wallpaper in and grow the frame, bar and notch into place when the shell starts (boot or reload). Off makes everything appear at once, as stock.

fields.label: Enter duration, milliseconds
fields.description: Base time E for the way in: the frame takes E, the bar, notch and dock start after 0.45 E and take E, the wallpaper fade takes 1.4 E.

fields.label: Leave duration, milliseconds
fields.description: Base time L for the way out before a reload (via `ambxst run reload`, the roadie IPC target, or the optional ambxst wrapper): bar, notch and dock take 0.85 L, the frame starts after 0.2 L and takes L, the wallpaper fade starts after 0.1 L and takes 1.4 L. Everything eases in and out.

fields.label: Cover a cold kill with the veil helper
fields.description: Keep a tiny detached helper that, if the shell is killed without leaving first (a plain `ambxst reload` with no wrapper), shows the last wallpaper and frame and plays the leave animation itself, then holds the background colour until the new shell is up. Needs a reload to start or stop the helper.

fields.label: Lock after boot
fields.description: Auto: lock with the Ambxst lockscreen once the wallpaper and frame are in, unless you logged in through a greeter (SDDM, GDM, LightDM, greetd, ly...) or an external locker such as hyprlock is already up. Autologin through a greeter still locks. The bar, notch and dock stay off screen until you unlock. Always / Never: no detection.

fields.label: On-screen display (volume, microphone, brightness)
fields.description: Quiet at start: the pop-up is not shown for the reports the services make while reading their initial state after a start (the volume and microphone sync during the first seconds, and each monitor's first brightness read, which on DDC monitors can land many seconds in); real changes still show it. As stock: always show it. Off: never show it.

fields.label: Say goodbye on reboot and power off
fields.description: Reboot and Power Off in the power menu grow the notch into the whole screen and show a line from a film or show before the command runs: a goodbye for a shutdown, a back-in-a-second for a reboot. Escape backs out; a click, Return or Space stops waiting once the quote is up. Your own quotes go in ~/.config/ambxst/roadie-quotes.json (see the README). Off: both run at once, as stock.

fields.label: Farewell expansion, milliseconds
fields.description: How long the notch takes to grow over the screen (ease-in-out). The quote then takes 0.7 s to fade in.

fields.label: Farewell reading time, milliseconds
fields.description: How long the quote stays up before the command runs, on top of 40 ms for every character of it (a short line about 2 s, the longest about 5 s at the default).

fields.label: Show where the quote is from
fields.description: A small line under the quote naming the film or show.
